about: Live show nights for the On This Day Mac widget. The widget reads this file once a day and shows 'live tonight' on each night listed. A run repeats every week from 'first' to 'last' on the same weekday; leave 'last' as null to keep it going. Put any week that is off in 'skip'. Dates are year-month-day.
